physical_label_rule: on L, W=+sqrt(K)=abs(R_L), hence the physical boundary follows D_L^{sign(R_L)} segmentwise
pole_split_rule: both D_L^+ and D_L^- occur in the pullback pole divisor for q_g1,q_g2,q_g3
sheet_switch_gate: R_L=W=0; for pair incidence K(p)=Ri(p)^2=Rj(p)^2 and sign relation changes only at K(p)=0
simultaneous_resolution: blow up constant smooth incidence sections in decreasing multiplicity over a generic transverse Q disk
scope_exclusion: intersections of Q=0 with the frozen discriminant, coefficient, or soft-support union
